content.text:
**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 6(a) termination for convenience.**

- **Issue:** Convenience termination is available only "[a]t any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding," so Clear Capital cannot exit for convenience while work is live, and there is no pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. Worse, the right is symmetric and runs on just 15 days' notice, letting RadialSpark walk away — well under the 90-day walk-away floor. The Term clause (§ 2) runs indefinitely until termination under § 6, so this is our only exit route.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** Company may terminate the Agreement or any SOW for convenience, in whole or in part, on 30 days' written notice with refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty; Contractor's convenience right is limited to periods with no outstanding SOW and raised to 90 days' notice.
- **Fallback offered in the comment:** 60 days' notice for Company, provided Contractor's right stays confined to no-SOW periods on 90 days' notice.
